Recent appointments include a surveillance colonoscopy with gastroenterology and thyroid screening with endocrinology, both unremarkable. He continues to manage his comorbidities with amlodipine, valsartan, lisinopril, metoprolol, empagliflozin, atorvastatin, simvastatin, and paracetamol as needed. He denies any new bone pain, haematuria, or weight loss.

Digital rectal examination reveals a symmetrically enlarged prostate with a smooth surface and no palpable nodules, consistent with clinical stage cT1c. General examination shows a stable, well-nourished male with no signs of acute distress. Abdominal examination is soft and non-tender, with no palpable masses or lymphadenopathy.
